parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json; const src=$('Validate and Dispatch').first().json; if(!response?.success) return [{json:{success:false,request_id:src.request_id,action:src.action,data:null,error:'Managed channel provisioning failed'}}]; return [{json:{success:true,request_id:src.request_id,action:src.action,data:{configured:true,channel_id:src.channel_id,connection_key:src.connection_key,channel_type:src.channel_type,provider_type:src.provider_type,provider_account_label:src.provider_account_label||null},error:null}}];

const src=$('Validate and Dispatch').first().json; const response=$input.first().json; const row=response?.route; if(!row || Number(row.channel_id)!==Number(src.channel_id)) return [{json:{success:false,request_id:src.request_id,action:src.action,data:{configured:false},error:'Managed channel provider route is not configured'}}]; if(src.action==='channel.check') return [{json:{success:true,request_id:src.request_id,action:src.action,data:{configured:true,channel_id:Number(row.channel_id),connection_key:String(row.connection_key),channel_type:String(row.channel_type),provider_type:String(row.provider_type),provider_account_label:row.provider_account_label||null},error:null}}]; return [{json:{...src,_dispatch:'channel_provider',provider_url:String(row.provider_url),provider_secret:String(row.provider_secret)}}];
